description: Make classic memes in seconds: upload a photo or start from a blank background, add top and bottom captions in bold meme style, and download as a PNG.

faqs.a: Yes — leave the image empty and pick any background color. You get a plain square canvas with your top and bottom captions.
faqs.q: Can I make a meme without uploading a photo?

faqs.a: Classic meme text is white with a thick black outline, which stays readable on any background. You can change the fill color if you like.
faqs.q: Why is the text white with a black outline?

faqs.a: No. The meme is drawn on a canvas in your browser and downloaded directly — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

howto: Upload a photo, or leave it empty and pick a background color for a plain meme.
Type your TOP TEXT and BOTTOM TEXT captions.
Adjust the font size slider and text color — the preview updates live.
Click “Download meme” to save it as a PNG.
title: Meme Generator
